description: This file defines generic client types and methods for interacting with Kubernetes resources, including support for listing, watching, creating, updating, deleting, patching, and applying declarative configurations.

classes.name: objectWithMeta
classes.description: Interface matching objects implementing both runtime.Object and metav1.Object.

classes.name: namedObject
classes.description: Interface for comparable objects with a GetName() method, used for apply configurations.

classes.name: Client
classes.description: Generic client for Kubernetes resources, supporting basic CRUD operations.

classes.name: ClientWithList
classes.description: Client with support for listing resources.

classes.name: ClientWithApply
classes.description: Client with support for apply declarative configurations.

classes.name: ClientWithListAndApply
classes.description: Client supporting both listing and applying configurations.

methods.name: PrefersProtobuf
methods.description: Option to set client to prefer protobuf encoding.

methods.name: NewClient
methods.description: Constructs a new resource client without list or apply support.

methods.name: NewClientWithList
methods.description: Constructs a new client with list support.

methods.name: NewClientWithApply
methods.description: Constructs a new client with apply support.

methods.name: NewClientWithListAndApply
methods.description: Constructs a client with support for both listing and applying.

methods.name: List
methods.description: Lists resources based on label and field selectors.

methods.name: Patch
methods.description: Applies a patch to a resource.

methods.name: Apply
methods.description: Applies a declarative configuration to a resource.

methods.name: ApplyStatus
methods.description: Applies a declarative configuration to the status subresource.
